prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy/layout/redesign, home hint/layout, sign_in hint/incentive/layout/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) is helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification), waiting screen info (home, wait_info), waiting screen redesigns (home, redesign), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than noise-corrected measured results.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout that prominently displays the adopted pet. (why: Redesigning adoption screens has delivered winning results in past tests, and adoption has a long median duration of 89s.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet style selector sub-flow on pick friend screen: Add an interactive choice card component to select pet color variations during friend selection. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet results looking wrong or failing; explicit style selection improves user expectations.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Centered layout redesign for story intro screen: Redesign the story screen into a centered layout focusing attention on the pet app introduction. (why: The choose_path step loses 16.9% of users; a cleaner centered narrative screen improves initial engagement.)
3: [home, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the pet setup waiting screen into a balanced two-column view separating status from pet previews. (why: The waiting/home step takes a mean duration of 2336s and loses 18.7% of users; layout redesign improves visual clarity.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in retry hint on sign-in screen: Display a fallback troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen for users experiencing connection stalls. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or not appearing, causing 24.0% dropoff at sign-in.)
5: [finish, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the final home intro screen using a two-column layout showing pet controls alongside completion actions. (why: Finish step has the biggest drop-off (35.2%) with a mean duration of 5815s; 3 support tickets reported confusion over controls.)
6: [adoption, layout] Compact layout redesign for photo upload screen: Switch the photo upload screen to a compact layout bringing upload buttons closer to photo guidelines. (why: Adoption step has high mean time (1017s); compacting layout speeds up the custom pet creation process.)
7: [adoption, new_screen] New pet care guide screen before adoption certificate: Add a new screen 'new_pet_guide' right before adoption certificate explaining how desktop pet interactions work. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding; introducing pet care guidance earlier reduces confusion.)
8: [sign_in, incentive] Troubleshooting checklist component on sign-in screen: Add a quick sign-in help checklist component on the sign-in screen to resolve account stalls. (why: 8 support emails cited missing/reset pets after sign-in and 2 cited sign-in stalls, leading to 24.0% dropoff.)
9: [finish, redesign] Centered layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the home intro completion screen to a clean centered layout highlighting onboarding completion. (why: Finish conversion is the lowest in the funnel at 64.8%; streamlining the final screen improves completion.)
